contexts.text: That in (the sense of the letter) there is Divine truth such as is in the Heavens, is signified by, He hath set darkness as His hiding place ( 1).
That his life's love may come forth from its hiding places...

The treasures of darkness, and the hidden riches of the hiding places () = interior intelligence and wisdom from Heaven; for the things which enter... from Heaven... come secretly, and affect all things with the man...
To shoot the upright in secret-places () = to deceive those who are in truths from good.
Lest from too much light and from too much shade falsities should break in, is signified by, it shall be for a refuge and hiding place from the inundation and the rain ().
The hiding places from which the serpent bites and in which it hides itself = cunning.
A lion in secret-places () = that the interior natural man, from the evils in him, perverts every sense of truth of the Word... whence come falsities.
To trust in the hiding place of His wings () = in Divine truths...
